title: BEST INFINITE IRON FARM 1.21+ Minecraft Bedrock & MCPE
description:
In this video, I will show you how to make this new iron farm for Minecraft. It is fast, it is cheap, and it can be made in just 15 minutes simple to build, but fast. It can be made in air or underground bases, it is expandable and stackable, making it a reliable choice for the early game in Minecraft Bedrock!

If you enjoyed this channel, it will focus on high-performance and simple farms that are beyond the bedrock level, so be sure to turn on notifications to stay informed!
